trees. Localized power outages are possible. Unsecured
light objects may become projectiles.

Wilson-Conococheague, Falling Waters, Clear Spring, Hedgesville,
Pecktonville, Big Spring, Big Pool, Cherry Run, Johnsontown,
Warrenton, Spohrs Crossroads, Spruce Pine Hollow, Sleepy Creek, and

building.
